Nueces County covers 839 square miles on the Coastal Bend with about 353,000 residents centred on Corpus Christi. The Port of Corpus Christi is the largest crude-oil export gateway in the United States, and refining and petrochemicals follow it. Hurricane exposure and the resulting windstorm insurance market are a real cost line on the barrier-island and bayfront property here. Median home value is $208,800 against median household income of $67,000.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
